The published refund rate 0.473684 (27/57) counts a customer as refunded after any refund above zero, and 15 of the 27 had only partial refunds; counting only customers with a full refund gives 0.210526 (12/57), and the order-row basis the spec rejected gives 0.189655 (33/174), because the spec pins
No customer in the population has zero or negative net revenue across their orders, so the open question of whether a fully refunded customer still counts as paying moves no number on this export.

revenue_recognition net_of_refunds deducts every refund from the quarter of its order because the export has no refund date, so refunds issued after 2025-03-30 on Q1 orders lower Q1 net revenue (35741.52 after 4493.50 of refunds); the data cannot show whether that matches the accounting practice.

The spec period ends 2025-03-30, not at the calendar quarter end 2025-03-31, while questions.md and the exclusion reason call it the reported quarter; no row is dated 2025-03-31, so nothing moves on this export, but a later export's 31 March orders would be dropped as outside the quarter, and no row
timezone_for_dates Europe/Warsaw moves no number because order_date is a plain date with no time of day, so this ruling cannot be tested on this export.

No deterministic rule covers the text of the answer files (R04's rule labels, R02's basis sentence), the rule-to-reason pairing in clean_data/exclusions.json, excluded_outside_period on its own (only the sum invariant pins it), carry contents or report prose; I checked each by hand and only R04 fail
